To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
selective encryption is not suitable for most compression systems, while modified entropy coders can provide a secure solution for multimedia compression systems.

selective encryption is a suitable approach only when the encryption is applied to the most important part of the compressed data and the encryption key is not used in the compression process; and that modified entropy coders are a promising approach to achieve security without sacrificing the compression quality and the speed.

(1) selective encryption is not a general-purpose solution for multimedia compression systems, (2) the entropy coder can be turned into a secure cipher using multiple statistical models, and (3) the proposed modified entropy coding scheme is a practical solution to secure multimedia compression systems.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing new methods to protect multimedia data against various security threats.

two issues: 1) to provide a systematic way of integrating compression and encryption; 2) to design secure and efficient multimedia compression systems that are suitable for the real-time applications.
the design of integrated multimedia compression/encryption systems, and we propose two approaches for this purpose, namely, selective encryption and modified coders with multiple models.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the modified entropy coder approach is a better approach than selective encryption for most compression systems.
the two approaches of selective encryption and modified statistical models for the entropy coders can provide a good trade-off between compression performance and security.
encryption can be integrated with multimedia compression systems in many ways, and the choice of which method to use depends on the specific compression system and application requirements.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have provided two general approaches for integrating encryption into multimedia compression systems.
encryption can be integrated into a compression system without affecting compression performance, computational speed and the security level.
we have developed a new methodology for designing integrated multimedia compression and security systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the design of an integrated multimedia compression and cryptography system should be based upon the characteristics of the compression system, and the design should be done at the system level rather than the algorithmic level.
the design of an encryption system for a multimedia compression system must be done in a holistic way, i.e., the encryption system must be designed with the compression system in mind.
entropy coders with different models can be turned into encryption ciphers, and the security can be achieved without sacrificing the computational speed.
